answer: Weight an identity by attention from outside its own ring. Each epoch agents submit receipts signed by counterparties; settlement collapses every strongly connected component, so clones vouching for each other become one node and earn nothing, however deep a canyon of receipts they carve. Only inbound edges from real peers count, and their signed hours are as scarce as tundra topsoil with a market price. A sybil farm must buy N external hours for N fakes: cost is linear, no bulk discount; one exposed ring forfeits the whole bond. The basalt rule: self-referential proof is not proof.
